let rotasticCpdEventIndex = 0;
let rotasticCpdSlotCounter = 0;

function chooseActiveCpdEvent() {
  const today = (typeof getQatarClock === 'function' && getQatarClock().isoDate) || new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  const active = ROTASTIC_CPD_EVENTS.filter(function(item) { return item && item.endDate >= today; });
  if (!active.length) return null;
  const event = active[rotasticCpdEventIndex % active.length];
  rotasticCpdEventIndex = (rotasticCpdEventIndex + 1) % active.length;
  return event;
}

let rotasticQatarAchievementFetchedAt = 0;
let tickerSlotCounter = 0;
let rotasticContentCycleIndex = 1; // opening greeting is step 0; next is Abu Nakhla
let regularTickerIndex = 0;
let regularTickerDeck = [];
let prayerTickerIndex = 0;
let pendingPrayerTicker = false;
let pendingCentreTicker = false;
let rotasticTickerLastRenderAt = 0;
let rotasticOpeningSequenceHasRun = false;

function shuffleArray(items) {
  const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items.slice() : [];
  for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    let j;
    try {
      const random = new Uint32Array(1);
      crypto.getRandomValues(random);
      j = random[0] % (i + 1);
    } catch (e) {
      j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    }
    const temp = arr[i];
    arr[i] = arr[j];
    arr[j] = temp;
  }
  return arr;
}

function refillRegularTickerDeck() {
  const messages = getRegularTickerMessages();

  const medicalRegional = [];
  const medicalInternational = [];
  const colleagueAdvice = [];

  messages.forEach(function(message) {
    const s = String(message || '').toLowerCase();
    const hasNumber = /\d/.test(message);

    if (!hasNumber) {
      colleagueAdvice.push(message);
    } else if (/qatar|doha|phcc|hamad|hmc|moph|gcc|gulf|saudi|uae|emirat|kuwait|bahrain|oman|mena|middle east|arab|jordan|egypt|lebanon|morocco|tunisia|iraq|turkey|turkish|pakistan|pakistani/.test(s)) {
      medicalRegional.push(message);
    } else {
      medicalInternational.push(message);
    }
  });

  const regional = shuffleArray(medicalRegional);
  const international = shuffleArray(medicalInternational);
  const advice = shuffleArray(colleagueAdvice);

  const fallbackAdvice = [
    '😊 Hope you have a smooth shift.',
    '💧 Hydrate when you get a quiet minute.',
    '✨ One patient at a time.',
    '☕ 2 quiet minutes can help reset.',
    '🤝 Keep the handover short and clear.',
    '📝 Document the plan while it is fresh.',
    '🧠 Difficult case? Ask a colleague early.',
    '📞 Close the loop on important referrals.',
    '🩺 A quick medication check can prevent errors.',
    '🌿 Take a brief pause when the workload allows.',
    '📌 Highlight red flags clearly.',
    '📏 Correct cuff size matters.',
    '📖 Teach-back can reveal misunderstandings.',
    '🙌 Thank a colleague who helped.',
    '🧘 A calm tone helps in a busy queue.'
  ];

  const deck = [];
  let r = 0, i = 0, a = 0;
  let takeRegional = true;

  // Strict interleaving. Every medical/statistical item is followed by
  // a colleague-advice item before another medical fact can appear.
  while (r < regional.length || i < international.length) {
    let fact = '';

    // Qatar/GCC/Arab facts are strongly preferred. International facts
    // are occasional rather than clustered.
    if (r < regional.length && (takeRegional || i >= international.length)) {
      fact = regional[r++];
    } else if (i < international.length) {
      fact = international[i++];
    } else if (r < regional.length) {
      fact = regional[r++];
    }

    takeRegional = !takeRegional;

    if (fact) deck.push(fact);

    let adviceMessage = '';
    if (a < advice.length) {
      adviceMessage = advice[a++];
    } else {
      adviceMessage = fallbackAdvice[(a++) % fallbackAdvice.length];
    }
    deck.push(adviceMessage);
  }

  // If there are more advice items than facts, add them at the end.
  while (a < advice.length) deck.push(advice[a++]);

  regularTickerDeck = deck.length ? deck : shuffleArray(messages);
  regularTickerIndex = 0;
}

let lastRegularTickerWasFact = false;

function getNextShuffledRegularMessage() {
  if (!regularTickerDeck.length || regularTickerIndex >= regularTickerDeck.length) {
    refillRegularTickerDeck();
  }
  if (!regularTickerDeck.length) return '';

  let message = regularTickerDeck[regularTickerIndex++];
  const isFact = /\d/.test(message);

  // Hard guard: a medical/statistical fact cannot directly follow another
  // medical/statistical fact, even after a deck refresh.
  if (lastRegularTickerWasFact && isFact) {
    const spacers = [
      '😊 Hope you have a smooth shift.',
      '💧 Hydrate when you get a quiet minute.',
      '✨ One patient at a time.',
      '☕ 2 quiet minutes can help reset.',
      '🤝 Keep the handover short and clear.',
      '📝 Document the plan while it is fresh.',
      '🧠 Difficult case? Ask a colleague early.',
      '📞 Close the loop on important referrals.',
      '📌 Highlight red flags clearly.',
  

---
ment.message,
      6500
    );
    return;
  }

  // Normal stream: fixed category order, shuffled content inside each category:
  // Every cycle includes motivational lines and practical clinical advice.
  // 0 Greeting (brief)
  // 1 Qatar / PHCC medical statistic
  // 2 Relevant prayer
  // 3 Qatar / Arab-region medical news
  // 4 Positive safe-practice advice
  // 5 Qatar / PHCC medical statistic
  // 6 Abu Nakhla identity animation
  // 7 Greeting (brief, different positive line)
  // 8 Qatar / Arab-region medical news
  // 9 Current QNA / Al Jazeera headline
  // 10 Qatar / PHCC medical statistic
  // 11 Positive doctor encouragement
  // 12 Qatar / Arab-region medical news
  // 13 NHS global/relevant health item
  // 14 Abu Nakhla identity animation
  // then repeat.
  // This makes public-health statistics and medical news much more visible.

  if (isAdminNotice && tickerSlotCounter % 3 === 1) {
    renderTickerCard('admin', conciseTickerText(rawItem, 105), 6500);
    return;
  }

  const cycleStep = rotasticContentCycleIndex % 15;
  rotasticContentCycleIndex = (rotasticContentCycleIndex + 1) % 15;

  if (cycleStep === 0 || cycleStep === 7) {
    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5800);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 1 || cycleStep === 5 || cycleStep === 10) {
    rotasticMedicalStatCycleCount += 1;

    // Keep the stream focused on public-health numbers. Qatar fun facts remain
    // occasional rather than replacing a quarter of the medical-stat slots.
    const stat = chooseWeightedMedicalStat();
    if (stat) {
      renderTickerCard('stat', stat, 6000);
      return;
    }

    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 2) {
    const prayerMessage = getPrayerTickerMessage(prayerTimes);
    if (prayerMessage) {
      renderTickerCard('prayer', conciseTickerText(prayerMessage, 98), 6000);
      return;
    }
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 3 || cycleStep === 8 || cycleStep === 12) {
    rotasticCpdSlotCounter += 1;
    if (rotasticCpdSlotCounter % 4 === 1) {
      const cpdEvent = chooseActiveCpdEvent();
      if (cpdEvent) {
        rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = cpdEvent.link;
        rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {name:'CPD event', domain:(new URL(cpdEvent.link)).hostname.replace(/^www\./,'')};
        renderTickerCard('medicalnews', cpdEvent.text, 7600);
        return;
      }
    }

    const medicalHeadline = chooseLatestMedicalHeadline();

    if (medicalHeadline) {
      renderTickerCard('medicalnews', medicalHeadline, 6500);
      return;
    }

    // This branch should be rare because chooseLatestMedicalHeadline also has
    // trusted-source landing-page fallbacks.
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 4) {
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 6 || cycleStep === 14) {
    renderCentreIdentityCard();
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 9) {
    const headline = chooseWorldHeadlineWithSource();

    if (headline) {
      renderTickerCard(headline.type, headline.text, 6300);
      return;
    }

    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5600);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 11) {
    const weatherUpdate = getActualDohaWeatherTickerText();
    if (weatherUpdate && tickerSlotCounter % 2 === 0) {
      rotasticCurrentTickerSourceMeta = {name:'Doha Weather', domain:'open-meteo.com'};
      renderTickerCard('general', weatherUpdate, 7800);
      return;
    }
    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 7800);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 13) {
    const evidenceItem = (tickerSlotCounter % 2 === 0)
      ? (chooseNiceGuidanceTickerItem() || chooseNhsRelevantHeadline())
      : (chooseNhsRelevantHeadline() || chooseNiceGuidanceTickerItem());
    if (evidenceItem) {
      renderTickerCard('medicalnews', evidenceItem, 8200);
      return;
    }
    renderTickerCard('safepractice', nextSafePracticeAdvice(), 7800);
    return;
  }

  renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5600);
}

  renderNextTickerSlot();

let headlineTickerTimer = null;
let headlineTickerPhase = 'stream';




const ROTASTIC_ROOM_HERO_DURATION_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;
const rotasticRoomHeroOpenedAt = Date.now();
let rotasticRoomHeroTimer = null;

function getTodayRoomInfoForActiveDoctor() {
  const doctor = activeUserDocName || getSplashDoctorName();
  const day = getTodayScheduleDay();

  if (!doctor || !day) return null;

  const timing = getDoctorShiftTiming(day, doctor);
  if (!timing) return null;

  const shift = day[timing.period];
  if (!shift) return null;

  const rooms = getRoomAssignmentsForDoctor(shift, doctor);
  if (!rooms.length) return null;

  return {
    rooms: rooms,
    period: timing.period,
    shiftLabel: timing.label,
    day: day
  };
}

function renderMainRoomHero() {
  const card = document.getElementById('mainRoomHero');
  const number = document.getElementById('mainRoomHeroNumber');
  const context = document.getElementById('mainRoomHeroContext');
  if (!card || !number || !context) return;

  const remaining = ROTASTIC_ROOM_HERO_DURATION_MS - (Date.now() - rotasticRoomHeroOpenedAt);
  const info = getTodayRoomInfoForActiveDoctor();

  if (remaining <= 0 || !info) {
    card.classList.add('hidden');
    return;
  }

  number.textContent = info.rooms.join(' / ');
  context.textContent =
    info.rooms.length === 1
      ? info.shiftLabel + ' • keep this room in mind for your first part of the shift'
      : info.shiftLabel + ' • multiple room allocations today';

  card.classList.remove('hidden');

  if (rotasticRoomHeroTimer) clearTimeout(rotasticRoomHeroTimer);
  rotasticRoomHeroTimer = setTimeout(function() {
    card.classList.add('hidden');
  }, remaining);
}

const rotasticLaunchWishIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * ROTASTIC_SHIFT_WISHES.length);

function getRotasticShiftWish() {
  return ROTASTIC_SHIFT_WISHES[rotasticLaunchWishIndex] ||
    'Wishing you a safe and smooth shift today.';
}
